spaced_repetition.description: Har bir so'z o'rganilgan kundan keyin shu kunlarda hikoyada qayta chiqadi. Kechki hisobotda 'unutdim' deb belgilangan so'z ertangi hikoyaga ham qo'shiladi.

daily_tasks_template.uz: 3 ta savolga to'liq gap bilan javob bering
Hikoyani o'zingiz haqida qayta aytib bering (My name is...)
Arab harflari: har birini 5 qatordan yozing, so'zlarni o'qing

day_completed_rule: Vazifalarning yarmidan ko'pi bajarilsa kun 'bajarildi' hisoblanadi

days.story: My name is Ali. I am forty years old. I live in a small town. I work in a hospital. I like my work. I have two sons. My sons like football. I like football too. In the evening I work in my garden. I live near my work. My name is Ali, and I like my life.
questions: Where does Ali live?
What does Ali like?
How many sons does Ali have?
days.retell_frame: My name is ___. I am ___ years old. I live in ___. I work in ___. I have ___. I like ___.

arabic.note_uz: ب ت ث shakli bir xil: ب pastda 1 nuqta, ت tepada 2 nuqta, ث tepada 3 nuqta

days.story: My name is Karim. I live in a big house with my family. I have a wife and three sons. My father and mother live with us too. I work in a shop every day. In the evening I come home. I like to sit together with my family. One day my son asked: "Father, why are you always kind to us?" I said: "The Prophet ﷺ said: The best of you are those who are best to their families." Now my sons help their mother every day. We are happy together.

hadith.en: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.
hadith.uz: Sizlarning eng yaxshingiz oilasiga eng yaxshi bo'lganingizdir. Men esa oilamga sizlarning eng yaxshingizman.

questions: Who lives in Karim's house?
What does Karim like to do in the evening?
What do his sons do now?
days.retell_frame: I have a family. My family is ___. I like to ___ together with my family.

arabic.note_uz: ج pastda 1 nuqta, ح nuqtasiz, خ tepada 1 nuqta

days.story: My name is Yusuf. I live in a small village. I work in a shop. I have a big family. Every evening I read a book. I like to learn new things. One day my father said: "Son, the Prophet ﷺ said: Whoever takes a path to seek knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise." Now my family and I read together every evening.

hadith.en: Whoever takes a path to seek knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
hadith.uz: Kim ilm talabida yo'lga chiqsa, Alloh unga jannat yo'lini oson qiladi.

questions: What does Yusuf do every evening?
What did his father say?
What does his family do now?
days.retell_frame: Every evening I ___. I like to learn ___. Learning is ___.

arabic.note_uz: د va ذ: ذ tepada 1 nuqta. ر va ز: ز tepada 1 nuqta

days.story: My name is Bobur. I live in a village. Every morning I wake up early. I work in my field. The work is hard, but I like it. I have a small shop too. I earn money with my own hands. Every evening I read and learn something new. Learning is not easy, but it is useful. My grandfather told me: "The Prophet ﷺ said: No one eats better food than the food he earns with his own hands." Now I eat my bread with a happy heart.

hadith.en: No one has ever eaten better food than what he eats from the work of his own hands.
hadith.uz: Hech kim o'z qo'li mehnati bilan topganidan yaxshiroq taom yemagan.

questions: When does Bobur wake up?
Is his work easy?
What did his grandfather tell him?
days.retell_frame: Every morning I wake up at ___. I work ___. My work is ___, but I like it.

arabic.note_uz: س nuqtasiz, ش tepada 3 nuqta. ص nuqtasiz, ض tepada 1 nuqta

days.story: Every morning I wake up early and go to work. On the way I see my neighbor. He is an old man. I always smile and say: "Good morning!" One day he said: "Your smile makes my morning happy." I remembered the words of the Prophet ﷺ: "Your smile in the face of your brother is charity." A smile is easy and free. Now my family and I smile at everyone. My wife and my mother help our neighbor too. Being kind is a good charity.

hadith.en: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.

questions: Who does he see every morning?
What did the neighbor say?
What does his family do now?
days.retell_frame: My neighbor is ___. I help ___. I smile at ___.

arabic.note_uz: ط nuqtasiz, ظ tepada 1 nuqta. ع nuqtasiz, غ tepada 1 nuqta

days.story: My friend Aziz is a strong man. But one day he was very angry. A boy broke his window with a ball. Aziz wanted to shout. Then he stopped, and he was calm. He said to the boy: "It's okay. Be careful next time." The boy said: "I'm sorry." Later I asked Aziz: "How did you control your anger?" He said: "I read a hadith. The Prophet ﷺ said: The strong man is not the one who wins in wrestling. The strong man is the one who controls himself when he is angry." Being patient is not easy, but we can learn it. Now Aziz and the boy are friends, and the boy always smiles at him.

hadith.en: The strong man is not the one who wins in wrestling; the strong man is the one who controls himself when he is angry.
hadith.uz: Kuchli odam kurashda yenguvchi emas, balki g'azab paytida o'zini tuta oladigan kishidir.

questions: Why was Aziz angry?
What did Aziz say to the boy?
Who is strong, according to the hadith?
days.retell_frame: When I am angry, I ___. I try to be calm and ___.

arabic.note_uz: ف tepada 1 nuqta, ق tepada 2 nuqta

days.story: My name is Umar. I am thirty-five years old. I live in a small town. I work as a doctor. Every morning I wake up early. Before I begin my work, I think about my intention. My teacher told me: "The Prophet ﷺ said: Actions are only by intentions." If my intention is good, my work is a good deed. Some days the work is hard, and some patients are angry. I stay calm and patient. I earn money, but the most important thing is the heart. I like my work because I help people.
questions: What does Umar do before he begins his work?
What happens when his intention is good?
What is the most important thing for Umar?
days.retell_frame: My name is ___. I work as ___. Before I begin my work, I ___. The most important thing for me is ___.
